topic: Student-led protests: Quebec student rallies against the 2026 provincial election (slogan 'Elections, a trap for fools') on Oct 3, and pro-Palestinian student walkout/demonstration at McGill on the Oct 7 anniversary
scale: a few hundred students in Montreal and Quebec City (CRUES coalition, 30,000 members); several hundred demonstrators in downtown Montreal on Oct 7
quote1: A few hundred students gathered in Montreal and Quebec City under the slogan “Elections: A Trap for Fools” ( Élections, piège à cons in French) to protest, among other things, the lack of parties that truly represent them, two days before general elections in which their age group has the lowest voter turnout rates.
quote2: We are here to continue to protest the ongoing genocide in Gaza, as we mark three years of genocide in Palestine,” said Iman Noor, a representative for Students for Palestine’s Honour and Resistance at McGill University.
